observations: Photo 0 shows a heavy-duty industrial sewing machine with the brand name 'TYPICAL' visible on the side of the machine head.
The machine is mounted on a white and blue table with a ruler along the edge and a blue plastic accessory holder.
The machine has a large pulley and appears to be a lockstitch or industrial straight-stitch type.
Photo 1 shows the underside of the machine, revealing a motor and belt drive system. The brand 'JUKY' is visible on the table frame.
The machine shows signs of use: dust, minor scratches, and some wear on the metal parts.
No power cord is visible in either photo.
The seller claims 'No fault, neatly used' but provides no proof of functionality.

claims.evidence: No video or photo of the machine operating. No proof of electrical connection or motor function. Dust and wear suggest use, but not malfunction.
The machine is clean overall, with no visible damage or major rust. The table and accessories are intact and orderly.

risks.risk: Machine may not work due to motor, belt, or electrical issues
risks.proof: Video of the machine running with the motor engaged and needle moving, or a photo of the power cord and plug.

risks.risk: Missing parts or accessories (e.g., power cord, foot pedal, bobbins)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories and the power cord.

risks.risk: Hidden mechanical damage or wear in the needle bar, feed dog, or motor shaft
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the needle bar, feed dog, and motor shaft area, or video of the machine running under load.

proof_requests: Video of the machine running with the motor engaged and needle moving.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
Close-up of the needle bar and feed dog area.
response.reason: The machine is identifiable as a TYPICAL industrial sewing machine, but its functionality is unverified. Without proof of operation, it cannot be priced as working. The seller's claim of 'no fault' is unverified, and hidden mechanical or electrical risks affect the price. Proof of operation and completeness is required before pricing.
